title: Quadratic form estimations for Hessian matrices of resistance distance and Kirchhoff index of positive-weighted graphs
summary: Let $G^{w}=(V,E,w)$ be a positive-weighted graph with the weight $w(e)>0$ for all $e\in E$. The weighted graph $G^{\widetilde{w}}=(V,E,\widetilde{w})$ is called a hyper-dual number weighted graph, where the weight $\widetilde{w}(e)=w(e)+Δw(e)(\varepsilon+\varepsilon^{*})$ is a hyper dual number, $Δw(e)$ is a real number, $\varepsilon$ and $\varepsilon^{*}$ are two dual units, $e\in E$. In this paper, we give a representation for the Moore-Penrose inverse of the Laplacian matrix, and calculation formulas for the resistance distance and Kirchhoff index of $G^{\widetilde{w}}$, respectively.
